kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أبتهل (form VIII)
# أَبْتَهِلُ (ʔabtahilu) /ʔab.ta.hi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَهَلَ (ibtahala)
# أَبْتَهِلَ (ʔabtahila) /ʔab.ta.hi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَهَلَ (ibtahala)
# أَبْتَهِلْ (ʔabtahil) /ʔab.ta.hil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِبْتَهَلَ (ibtahala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
